newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF pays 71.8 bln yen to private sector in April.
newsitem.headline: MOF pays 71.8 bln yen to private sector in April.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) paid out 71.8 billion yen to the private sector in April through its special foreign exchange account, Bank of Japan (BOJ) data showed on Thursday.
Analysts said most of the payments in April were related to the redemption of 51.6 billion worth of financing bills (FBs) which had been sold to the private sector.
MOF does not comment on the details of such payments.
The ministry manages Japan's external reserves, which stood at $219.36 billion at the end of March.
The private-sector institutions comprise commercial banks, foreign central banks, municipal governments, public funds and quasi-governmental organisations.
